Subject: Follow-up: token volumes + model mix (post-call recap)

Hi Sam — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a formal pricing proposal: 

Call recap (as I captured it):
- Primary use case: clinical notes summarization and patient Q&A for Acme Health’s telehealth product.
- Expected steady-state volume: ~120M tokens/month initially, scaling to ~350M over 12 months (see attached Acme_Monthly_Volumes.xlsx).
- Model mix (approx): chat/generation ~70%, embeddings ~20%, rerank/other text-scoring ~10%.
- Latency SLOs: 300–500ms median for chat flows; embeddings can be batch/offline.
- Security: data-in-transit encrypted, customer data residency in us-east required.

Key pricing/qualification items we discussed — please confirm:
1) Target unit economics: you mentioned a budget envelope and a target $/1M tokens — can you confirm the target range you’d be comfortable with?
2) Volume split validation: are the model mix percentages above correct for month 1 and expected for steady-state?
3) Preferred procurement path: self-serve API vs dedicated/reserved capacity (we discussed dedicated if you want predictable latency and price caps).

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm the numbers above, we’ll produce a 2‑option pricing proposal: Hosted API (usage) and Dedicated (reserved capacity) with example blended unit rates and an estimated monthly spend.
- I’ll loop in Aditya (SE) to scope instance sizing and possible quantized model variants to hit latency and cost targets.
- If helpful, we can also draft a preliminary SOW for dedicated onboarding.

Attached: Acme_Monthly_Volumes.xlsx (monthly token estimates)

Thanks — can you confirm the target $/1M you referenced on the call and the model mix?

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the concise recap, that matches our internal notes. Confirming the items you asked about: 

1) Target $/1M tokens: We’re looking at a target blended unit cost in the neighborhood of $7,000–$9,000 per 1M tokens while we ramp. That’s driven by our budget for this year and the need to keep per‑patient processing costs predictable.
2) Model mix: Yes — month 1 will likely be ~70% chat/generation, ~20% embeddings (for similarity and search), and ~10% rerank/scoring. Those are approximate but accurate enough for a pricing exercise.
3) Procurement path: We are open to dedicated/reserved if the price and SLAs look right — procurement will prefer a committed capacity option if we can lock in predictable unit economics.

Additional notes:
- Average context length for chat sessions will be ~1,200 tokens; generated output ~250 tokens on average.
- Embedding requests are batched (monthly offline jobs) but volume is significant during nightly windows.

Happy to take a pricing proposal + example SOW. We’re targeting an internal budget review week-of Mar 15, so any proposal before then would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sam

Marissa / Dylan — quick sketch below to use in the customer proposal. These are conservative estimates; final numbers will depend on chosen model variants and commit term.

Assumptions (from Sam): 120M tokens/month to start, ramp to 350M; model mix 70% chat / 20% embeddings / 10% rerank. Blended target Sam referenced: $7k–$9k per 1M tokens.

Option A — Hosted API (usage, no commit):
- Chat (redwood-chat-large, quantized): $8,500 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (redwood-embed-large): $2,200 per 1M embeddings tokens
- Rerank/scoring (redwood-rerank): $3,800 per 1M tokens
- Example blended @ Sam mix = (0.70*8500 + 0.20*2200 + 0.10*3800) = $6,350 per 1M tokens (note: because embedding tokens priced lower, blended can be below chat price)

Option B — Dedicated Reserved (12‑month commit, volume discount):
- Chat (dedicated quantized variant): $6,500 per 1M tokens (with 12m commit)
- Embeddings (dedicated batch node pricing): $1,800 per 1M
- Rerank: $2,900 per 1M
- Example blended @ Sam mix = (0.70*6500 + 0.20*1800 + 0.10*2900) = $5,340 per 1M tokens

Notes on model selection / perf: 
- For chat latency target (300–500ms median), we recommend redwood-chat-large quantized on Dedicated with continuous batching + KV cache. If Sam prefers lower cost and can tolerate slightly higher median latency, redwood-chat-medium gives ~25–30% lower cost.
- Embeddings: use batched dedicated CPU/GPU nodes for nightly jobs; recommend pre-warming during window to avoid cold start tails.
- Rerank: lightweight model variant on CPU/GPU depending on QPS; can colocate with chat in Dedicated to save cross-region egress.

Attachments: I can drop a preliminary SOW (SOW-draft.pdf) and a capacity sizing sheet if you want.

Next steps:
- Marissa: include these numbers in the external proposal and ask Sam which option (Hosted vs Dedicated) they want priced in the SOW.
- If they prefer Dedicated, we’ll draft a 12m commitment example showing monthly spend and cap.

Happy to jump on a call with Sam + procurement to walk pricing.

–Aditya
